title: Weather and Interior
author: Quentin Marchetti
blurb: Mirabel Amberdale, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
